services.name: 2 Hour Sea Life Cruise - Newport's Favorite Outdoor Adventure!
services.desc: Sea Life Cruise Welcome aboard the Discovery - A floating adventure for All Ages aboard the LARGEST cruiser on the Oregon Coast! 2 Hours $60 Adults (13 +) $35 Infant/Children (3 - 12) Children 2 and Under Cruise FREE! About the Cruise The Discovery, at 65-feet is the largest passenger cruiser on the Oregon Coast. It features spacious outdoor double decks for unlimited viewing throughout the cruise, seating in our indoor cabin, guest restrooms and endless supply of salty coastal breezes! Our Sea Life Cruises are a "Floating Adventure" endorsed by the Oregon Coast Aquarium!
